what: A flipbook where dozens of photos stacked in one spot switch to the next every .2 seconds with no transition (duration 0) — skims dozens of works in a few seconds. Click for the next one, drag sideways to advance one toward the dragged side. Pauses when offscreen or in a hidden tab

options.tap: 0 means no pressing or dragging to advance, only automatic advance (background slideshow — cursor too by default), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Overlapping photo slots — stacked to fill the panel. The front slot shows first

note: The original is Swiper (loop · autoplay delay 200 · speed 0 · centered), so dragging feels tactile. The part gives only the same tempo, without a library. It changes five times a second, so with reduced-motion it stops on the first slide.

from.where: index.html .sp-flip (center photo of the cover hero) — original carousel: data-autoplayspeed 200 · transition-immediate · enable-click-and-drag · cursor-right

index.html .wc-hero__slides (17 full-bleed background photos in the hero) — original Product background slideshow: Swiper 8 fade · autoplay delay 2200 · speed 0 · loop, a big white sentence sits on top so tapping doesn’t advance
